# Editors United

> Editors United Ltd. is a bilingual (English/French) video editing agency based in Montréal, Québec, Canada, founded in 2021 by Michael Attia. It specializes in short-form video (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) for coaches, financial advisors, real-estate agents, and creators across Canada and the USA.

## What we do

- Short-form video editing for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, built around hook optimization, retention pacing, captions, and calls to action
- Talking-head video editing
- Voiceover production
- Bilingual English/French versioning of the same video
- Monthly subscription packages with a dedicated editor; work is fully remote

## Who we serve

- Coaches and consultants
- Financial advisors
- Real-estate agents
- Content creators
- Clients across Canada and the USA; 150+ clients served and 2,500+ videos edited since 2017 (founder experience); rated 4.9/5 from 50+ client reviews

## Pricing

All prices are monthly, in CAD. Annual billing is about 15% less.

- Starter: $799/month, about 7 videos per month
- Growth: $1,499/month, 15 videos per month (most popular)
- Scale: $2,699/month, 30 videos per month

## Languages & location

- Languages: English and French (bilingual service and deliverables)
- Location: Montréal, Québec, Canada; founded 2021; founder Michael Attia
- Contact: support@editorsunited.com; calls booked via Calendly at https://editorsunited.com/contact
